subject: Re: Demo for BrightBank — calendar congestion / coverage plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Emerson <laura.emerson@brightbank.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: Proposed demo windows for BrightBank next week

Laura — thanks again for the quick intro call earlier. We’d love to run the full product walkthrough and a short 20–30 minute exec summary for your CTO. Proposed windows (PT):

- Tue 7/26 10:00–11:00
- Wed 7/27 13:00–14:00
- Thu 7/28 09:30–10:30

Sergio (SE) and I will both join unless you indicate you want a separate exec-only slot. Attached is a draft mutual action plan so you can see typical agenda and pre-reqs.

Next step: let me know which slot looks best and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: brightbank-mutual-action-plan.pdf

From: Laura Emerson <laura.emerson@brightbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightBank Scheduling <scheduling@brightbank.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: Proposed demo windows for BrightBank next week

Thanks, Marissa. Appreciate the options — execs are tight next week. Can you do Thu 7/21 11:00–11:45 PT (note: internal exec prep on different timezone, tight window)? If not, we can also do a compressed 30-minute exec-only on Tue 7/26 at 11:00.

One complication: our procurement lead prefers an all-in-session so legal can join for a short pricing Q&A. Would you be able to keep Sergio or another SE on hand for a few technical questions?

Laura
Laura Emerson
Head of Platform Strategy, BrightBank
laura.emerson@brightbank.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-21T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick: Proposed demo windows for BrightBank next week

Sergio / Soojin — BrightBank just asked for Thu 7/21 11:00–11:45 PT (earlier than the windows I sent). Sergio, I see you have an onsite at 11:00 that day — is there any flexibility? If not, can Soojin cover the live demo and you join briefly for the pricing Q&A, or should we record the walkthrough and run a separate technical deep-dive?

Options I’d prefer (ranked):
1) Soojin runs the demo live at 11:00; Sergio drops in for the last 15 minutes for technical Q&A.
2) Keep Sergio as SE, compress to 25–30 mins and focus on exec + legal; follow up with technical deep-dive next week.
3) Record full walkthrough (we can send a short recording + follow-up Q&A) — last resort.

Can you both confirm availability? I’ll communicate back to Laura and lock the invite.

—Marissa

Attachment: demo-slides-v2.pdf

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-21T12:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick: Proposed demo windows for BrightBank next week

Hey team — heads up: I’m booked onsite for an escalation at 10:30–13:00 PT that day (customer onsite). No realistic way to get to the 11:00 window. Two quick recommendations:

- Soojin has run BrightBank-like exec demos with our platform before and can run the session end-to-end. I can join a 15-min segment (11:30 PT) to cover any deep technical or procurement-specific questions.
- If BrightBank insists on having me for the full session, we should move to the 7/26 slot and signal that the technical deep-dive will be scheduled as a canary follow-up.

If you want, Vanessa can drop a short line to BrightBank to confirm coverage — she’s been handling handoffs lately and it smooths the ask. Otherwise Marissa, please confirm with Laura that Soojin will lead and I’ll carve out 11:30 for Q&A.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

Laura — quick update. We can meet at 11:00 PT on Thu 7/21 as requested. Soojin Lee (SE) will run the live walkthrough and lead the tech portion. Sergio Alvarez will join for the last ~15 minutes (11:30 PT) to handle procurement/legal technical questions.

Agenda (compressed):
- 11:00–11:10 Exec summary + value props (Marissa)
- 11:10–11:30 Live product walkthrough and customer scenarios (Soojin)
- 11:30–11:45 Technical Q&A + pricing touchpoints (Sergio)

We will record the session and share the recording and the two attachments (attached) immediately after. Calendar invite will follow — sending now.

Thanks for being flexible — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

See you Thursday.

Laura
